ācayagāmī:
[(1)ācaya+gamu+ṇī.(2)ācaya+gamu+ṇe+ṇī.(3)ācayaṃ(=ācinaṃ)+gamu+ṇī]  CL=9 Ācayagāminī refers to:
1. Dhamma (phenomena) that:
- Leads to accumulation (ācaya) of kamma and kilesas (defilements)
- Causes rebirth-linking (paṭisandhi), death (cuti), and destinations (gati)
- Leads beings to the cycle of suffering (vaṭṭa dukkha)
2. It can be understood in two ways:
(a) Dhamma that continuously:
- Accumulates suffering in saṃsāra
- Produces causes for further existence
- Leads to continued becoming
(b) Dhamma that operates by:
- Accumulating conditions for suffering
- Perpetuating the cycle of existence

ācārasampanna: [Ācāra+sampanna] (ti) CL=7 One who is fulfilled with morality and dignity.
ācārasampatti: [Ācāra+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 One who is fulfilled with morality.
ācārasamācārasikkhāpaka: [Ācāra+samācāra+sikkhāpaka] (ti) CL=7 One who teaches the good habits (good practice such as morals). See - Ācariya.
ācārasandhāraṇa: [Ācāra+sandhāraṇa] (na) CL=7 Observe well code of conducts and coventional.
ācārasaṇṭhāna: [Ācāra+saṇṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The existence of ethics (or) Established the rules of conduct,  Fulfilled the duties without fail.
ācārasikkhāpaka: [Ācāra+sikkhāpaka] (ti) CL=7 (Teacher) who teaches the rule of conduct.
ācārasikkhāpana: [Ācāra+sikkhāpana] (na) CL=7 (A) Practise and observe the practice which is without wearing clothing etc.,(that is his thought). (B) To be observed and practised morals and dignity.
ācārasikkhāpanaka: [Ācāra+sikkhāpanaka] (ti) CL=7 (Teacher) who teaches the way of reciting and the way of going,coming and how to live etc.,/
ācārasīla: [Ācāra+sīla] (na) CL=7 Morality, It is code of conduct which is distinguished and divided by relatives, region, doctrine.
ācārasīlamattaka: [Ācārasīla+mattaka] (na) CL=7 It is only Ācārasīla morals of upright person (It is only Ācārasīla which is small that is not inclusive first-rate qualities such as Indriyasaṃvara moral). (Indriyasaṃvara means restrain/control six senses).
ācārasīlasampanna: [Ācārasīla+sampanna] (ti) CL=7 One who is fulfilled with morality, One who is whether or not Magga Phala morals, whether or not the practice which is avoid for make living with 21 kinds of Anesana. (Anesana means seeking for unsuitable ways).
ācāraupacāraññū: [Ācara+upacāra+ñā+rū] (ti) CL=7 One who is skillful in practice.
ācāravantu: [Ācāra+vantu] (ti) CL=7 One who has good practice.
ācāravatta: [Ācāra+vatta] (na) CL=7 Code of conduct (or) Rules of conduct (or) Moral code.
ācāravatī: [Ācāravantu+ī] (thī) CL=7 One who named Ācāravatī, who is one daughter of Nigaṇṭha among five daughters.
ācāravinaya: [Ācāra+vinaya] (pu) CL=7 Ācāra vinaya, The practice dhamma which is discipline to be clever and polite.
ācāravipanna: [Ācāra+vipanna] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who has bad habits, A Bhikkhu who is guilty of breaking five kinds of Lahuka āpata. (B) One who is breaking the practice of upright person.
ācāravipatthicodanā: [Ācāravipatti+codanā] (thī) CL=7 Interrogate for five kinds of Ācāravipatti lahuka āpata.
ācāravipatti: [Ācāra+vipatti] (thī) CL=7 Breaking the code of conduct, (It is so called five kinds of Lahuka āpata āpata which is Thullacañaḥ pācitapāḷidesanī dukkaṭa dubbhāsī) (Lahuka means light (or) quick).
ācāravipattipaṭibāhaka: [Ācāravipatti+paṭibāhaka] (ti) CL=7 (Vinaya) which is prohibited for Ācāravipatti. (Ācāravipatti means breaking the code of conduct (five kinds of lower/light Apata).
ācāravirahita: [Ācāra+virahita] (ti) CL=7 One who don"t do filial duties/duties towards one"s mentors.
ācāraṭṭha: [Ācāra+attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning which is morals that is practise, fulfill and avoid.
ācārānusandhi: [Ācāra+anusandhi] (pu) CL=7 Related with code of conduct.
ācametu: [Ā+camu+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To wash (such as excrement, feet, hands) in toilet.
ācariyavasa: [Ācariya+vaṃsa] (pu) CL=7 The descendants of the teacher;The commentaries/Aṭṭhakathā which is cairred by suceession of teachers as convening a Buddhist synod. (Aṭṭhakathā means commentaries on Buddhist Pali texts).
